import collections

data = """region,product,units,unit_price_ekr
North,Kestrel-9,40,5500
North,Falcon-2,120,1800
North,SkyMapper Kit,75,950
South,Kestrel-9,22,5500
South,Falcon-2,160,1800
South,SkyMapper Kit,210,950
East,Kestrel-9,35,5500
East,Falcon-2,90,1800
East,SkyMapper Kit,130,950
West,Kestrel-9,18,5500
West,Falcon-2,140,1800
West,SkyMapper Kit,95,950"""

lines = data.strip().split('\n')[1:]
revenue_per_product = collections.defaultdict(float)

for line in lines:
    region, product, units, price = line.split(',')
    revenue_per_product[product] += int(units) * int(price)

max_product = max(revenue_per_product, key=revenue_per_product.get)
print(f"Product: {max_product}, Revenue: {revenue_per_product[max_product]}")
